messages:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — PR #842 (migrations guide v2->v3) is ready for review. Need approvals and merge before the release cutoff on Thu 18:00 PT. Docs preview link posted below. Main blockers: one stale link and a Python SDK snippet mismatch.
Sam: Taking a look now. @Jia can you own the snippet change? I'll triage the link.
Jia: Yep I can update the snippet. Question: do we call out the feature-flag rollout for the new behavior in the guide or hide behind the FF note?
Elaine: Good Q — product wants the migration doc live but gated by feature flag note. Add a short callout: "Behavior enabled when feature 'migrate_v3' is on".
Mike: CI just failed for the preview with a broken-link error: `/api/v1/old-endpoint` referenced in the migration steps. Replacing with `/api/v2/migrate` should fix it.
Sam: Found it in the 'Update endpoints' section — I'll submit a fix.
Jia: Updated the Python snippet in the branch, changed example to the new client call and added the FF callout. Snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.migrate_v3(payload)
```
Elaine: Awesome. Can someone kick the docs-preview CI after Sam's link fix lands? Need the green build at least 30m before cutoff.
Sam: Link fix pushed, requesting preview build now.
DocsBot: docs-preview: build started for PR #842 — https://previews.redwood.dev/842 (logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/842/logs)
Mike: Preview build failed earlier due to a lint rule in examples (line-length). I'll patch that in a follow-up commit.
Jia: Patch pushed for lint.
DocsBot: docs-preview: build succeeded for PR #842 — https://previews.redwood.dev/842
Elaine: Looks good on the preview. Decision: merge at Thu 17:30 PT (30m before cutoff) to allow any last-minute fixes and ensure the pinned version is updated. If anything red in the CI after merge, we'll hotfix and revert the pinned release docs. :thumbsup:
Sam: Sounds good. I'll merge at 17:30 PT unless someone objects.
Mike: No objections. I'll stay on standby for CI flakiness.
Jia: LGTM, thanks.
Elaine: Thanks team — tagging the release lead and product for visibility. @release-lead @product-team: PR queued to merge at Thu 17:30 PT, gated by feature flag note.
Sam: Merging now (scheduled).
DocsBot: Merge commit created: 5f2c9a1 — PR #842 merged into main. Automated release pin updated.
Mike: Monitoring rollout. If the FF goes live before the production deploy, we might need to coordinate an immediate docs hotfix.
Elaine: Noted. If any regressions, open a quick PR and ping this thread. Thanks all. :wave:
